article.title: What will the Democrats’ ‘Blue Wave’ mean for Trump’s foreign policy?
article.author: Michael Arria
article.content: Mondoweiss speaks with analyst Mitchell Plitnick about what the Democrats' "Blue Wave" could mean for Trump's foreign policy, how the Israeli elections could impact the United States, and how JD Vance is using Israel to position his political future.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
